back: Not as good as people say it is (opposite: underrated).
A performance or plot that is boring because it has been done so often.
Something so complex that it is impossible to understand.
Something that is impossible to believe (opposite: credible/believable).
Slightly immoral and likely to shock some people.
Extremely upsetting, often used to describe documentaries about difficult subjects.
Done or expressed in a simple but attractive and effective style.
When a work is very negatively criticised by the critics.
Highly praised by critics or the public.
A very great work of art.
When an actor is the wrong person for a particular role.
Always being associated with the same type of role (e.g., always playing a villain).
Calls from the audience at the end of a performance for the artist to repeat it or play more.
A performance of a specific piece of music or drama on a particular occasion.
When the audience stands up and applauds to show great appreciation.
